## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù treats the bodhisattva-girl *Lí gòu shī* 離垢施 (Skt. *Vimaladattā*, "Stainless Bestowing"). With *[Dé wú gòu nǚ jīng 得無垢女經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0031)* (T0339) it forms a parallel-translation pair on the same essential material.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù's Cháng'ān period (266 – 313 CE). The Taishō text (T0338) is established on the standard apparatus.
